reason: An interactive terminal plugin for reviewing Git diffs, annotating changed lines, and returning structured review feedback to the current Agent session.

summaries.zh: 在终端中交互式审查 Git 差异，支持对代码行添加结构化批注并将审查结果提交回当前 Agent 会话。
summaries.en: An interactive terminal plugin for reviewing Git diffs, adding structured line annotations, and submitting review feedback to the current Agent session.

capabilities: Reads Git unified diffs from tracked working-tree, staged, unstaged, or base-revision changes
Provides an interactive terminal interface for navigating diff files, hunks, and lines
Creates, edits, deletes, and submits structured review annotations to the current Agent session
Executes Git as a managed subprocess
